id: E5 v3 - one-time final test on the OPV2V test split: v2 plus dual-AP rule (D-64), PGD secondary families (D-65/D-67 plain, D-68 stealth), B-NORM baseline (D-66), D-69 reporting rules, per-family / mean-of-3 / realized-only tables and procedural checks
version: v3 (supersedes v2 runs/20261024-E5/preregistration_v2.json; v1 and v2 kept unchanged)
written: 2026-10-24, after the block-H PGD development run and before any test-scenario byte is downloaded. NOT RUN: the stream needs the user's explicit approval of the final test.
base: Every field of preregistration_v2.json holds as written unless changed below (data, allowlist, the 5 E4 families and seeds, B-RAY primary, R1 key secondary, Holm co-test, clean bound, strata, D-42 timing, stream safeguards, budget).
user_decisions: D-64, D-65, D-66 (decision_log_proposed_appendix.md, committed before any v3 computation); the user's approval of preregistration_v3 with the PGD families (chat, 2026-10-24)
frozen_note: v2's 19 files (unchanged, re-checked equal) + the model code, Stage-1 spike runner and checkpoint (audit e3) + the new v3 files. r1.py, baselines.py, pipeline.py unchanged (sha256 equal to v2). The v3 stream verifies every hash and the OpenCOOD commit before any network access and again after the run.

opencood.local_diff: none (git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no empty); untracked directory in this repo (.gitignore)

definitions.frame: OpenCOOD frame-order AP (global_sort_detections=False; frames concatenated in (scenario, frame) order; the v2 metric)
definitions.global: detections of all selected frames ranked by score (stable sort), same AP integral

D-64_dual_AP.rule: every primary and key-secondary statistic is computed under both definitions with the same bootstrap (seed 0, 2000 resamples, scenario and 10-frame). The v2 success rule (B-RAY Holm-rejected in the co-test with R1 vs no defense on the scenario bootstrap, and B-RAY clean relative loss scenario-CI high <= 1%) is evaluated separately per AP definition, Holm within each definition. A success/robustness claim requires a pass under BOTH. Headline numbers are quoted with global-ranking AP; frame-order AP is reported for comparability with OPV2V papers. If the two disagree the report states 'AP-definition-dependent'. R1 - B-RAY (statement by scenario CI, v2 wording) is reported under both, side by side.
D-64_dual_AP.code: runners/v3_analyze.criteria_v3 / d64; the frame-order path is checked to equal the frozen e5_analyze output (point and scenario CI) on the test caches (consistency_vs_frozen_v2)

B-NORM.rule: drop sender i entirely in a frame iff, at any scale k, mean|feature_i,k| / mean|feature_receiver,k| > tau_k; output = candidates decoded without the dropped senders
B-NORM.tau_definition: 99.5th percentile (numpy linear) over clean block-H sender-frames
B-NORM.code: src/mint/reliability/bnorm.py (no GT, no ledger); magnitudes recorded per condition in the stream (v3extra)

pgd_families.role: pre-registered SECONDARY attack families, reported per family, not part of the v2 primary mean. D-67: pgd_untargeted, pgd_remove (option 1, plain L-inf PGD) at r = 0.25, with B-NORM's catch rate and AP cost. D-68 (amended): pgd_untargeted_stealth, pgd_remove_stealth = the main PGD evaluation (B-NORM-aware). The stealth families were designed on exposed block H after its plain-PGD results were seen: POST HOC

threat_model.attacker: white-box (model weights, receiver features, fusion and heads known), single attacker = sender 1, perturbs only its own intermediate features at all 3 fusion scales; n = 1 frames: no attack (scored as clean, as every family)
threat_model.bound: L-inf per scale: |delta_k| <= eps_k = r * sigma_k; perturbed features projected onto >= 0 (the backbone blocks end in ReLU)

pgd.update: sign of the gradient, ascent, projection after every step

threat_model.pseudo_labels: no ground truth. Positive anchors = anchors whose clean fused score >= the post-processor score threshold (0.2; the pre-NMS set Y+ is selected from); the clean regression map at those anchors is the regression target

objectives.pgd_untargeted: maximise mean BCE(score, 1) over positives + mean BCE(score, 0) over negatives + mean smooth-L1(reg - reg_clean) over positive anchors' 7 regression values
objectives.pgd_remove: maximise mean BCE(score, 1) over positives (= minimise the scores of Y+ boxes)

threat_model.code: src/mint/attacks/pgd_v3.py (differentiable path asserted bitwise equal to the frozen decode on clean features)

stealth_projection.when: after the random start and after every PGD step, per scale k
stealth_projection.box: lo = max(-eps_k, -f_k), hi = eps_k (f + delta >= 0 everywhere)
stealth_projection.projection: exact Euclidean projection onto box and constraint: delta_k <- clip(delta_k - lambda_k, lo, hi); lambda_k = 0 if the constraint holds, else the smallest lambda_k >= 0 satisfying it, bisection on [0, max(delta_k - lo)] to tolerance 1e-7 x bracket; sums in float64

stealth.unchanged_from_D-65: objectives (pgd_untargeted_stealth uses pgd_untargeted's, pgd_remove_stealth uses pgd_remove's), 10 steps, step eps_k / 4, random start U(-eps_k, eps_k), sign-gradient ascent, final iterate, no-GT pseudo-labels from the clean fused output

selection_rule.rule: for each family, the smallest r in {0.25, 0.5, 1.0} whose all-frame attack loss AP@0.7(clean, no defense) - AP@0.7(attacked, no defense) under GLOBAL-ranking AP is >= 0.02 on block H; if no r reaches 0.02 the family is reported as 'too weak at realistic budgets' and run on the test at r = 1.0 anyway
selection_rule.fixed: before any PGD run on block H

pgd_untargeted_stealth.decision: D-68 as amended (main PGD evaluation; post hoc)

pgd_remove_stealth.decision: D-68 as amended (main PGD evaluation; post hoc)

D-68 stealth.B-NORM: catch rate <= 5% (about the clean false-flag rate)

operational_checks.B-RAY approx 0: point recovery < 0.10 under both AP definitions
operational_checks.R1 > 0: R1 dAP@0.7 scenario-CI low > 0 under both AP definitions
operational_checks.B-NORM <= 5%: sender-1 flag rate over attacked frames <= 0.05

expected_outcomes.stated: D-65 before any PGD run on H; D-68 before any stealth run on H

pgd_families.realized: n >= 2 and some clean Y+ box has no attacked Y+ box at BEV IoU >= 0.5 (pgd_remove, pgd_remove_stealth); n >= 2 and (some clean Y+ box has no attacked match, or some attacked Y+ box has no clean match) at BEV IoU >= 0.5 (pgd_untargeted, pgd_untargeted_stealth)
pgd_families.constraint_assertion: stealth: f + delta >= 0, |delta| <= eps_k, ratio_k <= 0.95 tau_k asserted on every attacked frame and scale in the stream (pgd_stealth.pgd_attack_stealth)
pgd_families.attacker: sender 1 at every n >= 2; n = 1 frames scored as clean

D-69_reporting.absolute_effects: absolute dAP in AP points next to every recovery
D-69_reporting.scope_limit: R1 cannot verify removals in receiver-blind regions (a removed object the receiver cannot see is UNKNOWN = keep)

secondary_tables_v3.per_family: every condition (clean, 4 original, spoof_blind, PGD at test levels) x every method: AP@0.7/0.5, dAP, recovery (None if attack loss < 0.005), attack loss; both AP definitions; scenario and 10-frame CIs
secondary_tables_v3.mean_of_3: mean dAP@0.7 over spoof_feat, shift_feat, spoof_pts (excluding remove_feat) per method, and R1 - B-RAY, with CIs, both AP definitions
secondary_tables_v3.realized_only: per family, frames where the attack was realized (E0-E5 definition; PGD as above): AP of clean and attacked on those frames, attack loss, dAP and recovery per method, 10-frame CIs, both AP definitions
secondary_tables_v3.B-NORM_flags: per condition: frames, sender-1 flagged (catch rate), any sender flagged; clean false-flag rate
secondary_tables_v3.not_criteria: descriptive; only D-64 + v2 success rule is a criterion

procedural_checks.before_stream: sha256 of every frozen file and the OpenCOOD commit/clean tree (v3_stream.verify_frozen); refuse on any mismatch
procedural_checks.interrupted_download: any ledger entry not 'complete' -> STOP and ask the user (no automatic restart)
procedural_checks.after_analysis: 15 scenarios and 2066 frames asserted (v3_analyze run_test completeness_check; STOP if not)
procedural_checks.consistency: frame-order v3 numbers of the v2 statistics equal the frozen e5_analyze output

streaming.other: as v2 (one scenario on disk, raw <= 3e9, free disk >= member + 5e9, raw deleted after both cache files are re-read)

estimated_runtime.basis: v2 estimate (about 8 h, range 7-10 h: download ~0.5 h, data pass + D-42 timing ~7.5 h) plus the v3 side record measured in the v3 dry run on this machine (n = 2: 16.1 s/frame, n = 5: 37.6 s/frame with replicated senders, n = 1: 0.5 s; linear in n between), applied to the 2066 test frames with the Stage-1 mean agent count per scenario; estimate only
estimated_runtime.b_norm_magnitudes_and_E4_attack_recomput: remainder of the side record (about 3 s/frame at n = 2)
estimated_runtime.analysis: e5_analyze test (frozen v2) under 1 h; v3_analyze test about 1-2 h (14 conditions x 6 methods x 2 AP definitions x 2 bootstraps of 2000 + realized-only)

analysis: python runners/e5_analyze.py test --run_dir runs/<date>-E5v3   (frozen v2 analysis -> e5_test.json)
python runners/v3_analyze.py test --run_dir runs/<date>-E5v3   (v3 -> e5_v3.json: criteria_v3 per AP definition, D-64 verdict, tables)

outcome.success: only if the v2 rule passes under both AP definitions (D-64); headline in global-ranking AP
outcome.failure: report as the result; no rescue analysis presented as confirmatory
outcome.no_rule_changes: no change to any method, attack, level, threshold, metric or criterion after this file is committed
